relations.label: dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan (7185) student of spu hrangs lo chung (7184)
relations.zotero_refs:
[R894SIKE]: 463 (dmar chos kyi rgyal po de ni | spu hrangs lo chung gi slob ma dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbon brgyud yin te |).
[R894SIKE]: 655 (de nas bu hrangs lo chung gi dngos slob dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan la bde mchog gi rgyud la sogs pa'i gsang sngags mang du gsan |). From the life of Phag mo gru pa (ID:3856).
[R894SIKE]: 826 (g.yor po lugs smad du pu hrangs lo tsA ba'i dngos slob dmar chos kyi rgyal po | mes ston kun snying | rngog mdo sde | lo tsA ba chos kyi bzang po'i slob ma bla ma gshen chen po dgung lo gya gsum bzhes pa dang mjal |). From the life or rGyal tsha (ID:7278), the chief disciple of Phag mo gru pa (ID:3856).
relations.support_notes: There seems to be some confusion in [R894SIKE] as to whether sPu hrangs was the teacher of dMar chos kyi rgyal mtshan (ID:7185) or of dMar chos kyi rgyal po (ID:7183). The former is more likely in view of the chronology of the two dMar, who were uncle and nephew.
